question: The annual average venture capital funding by year
query: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year, AVG(venture_capital_funding) AS avg_venture_capital_funding FROM finance_economics_dataset GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) ORDER BY year LIMIT 50;
answer:
